scope: Current local GEMC MINE inputs after open-square grooves and WLS truth update. Historical snapshot preserved separately. opticalHash identifies config/model, not the executable checksum.

mine_use_optical_table | 1 | counts | Use common optical_response.dat for geometry, transport and both sensors; 0 legacy model
mine_birks | 0.126 | counts | Birks mm/MeV
mine_light_yield | 8000 | counts | Extruded scintillator photons per MeV visible energy
mine_decay_time | 2.5 | ns | Scintillation exponential decay
mine_bulk_attenuation | 1000 | mm | Effective 100 cm bulk attenuation
mine_bulk_velocity | 170 | counts | Effective bulk speed in mm/ns
mine_collection_efficiency | 0.01 | counts | UNCALIBRATED pre-trapping capture and re-emission probability; NOT the 6.2 percent guided fraction
mine_readout_mode | 1 | counts | 0 reference; 1 WLS; 2 direct fiber
mine_fiber_model | 0 | counts | 0 Y-11(200) single clad; 1 future YS-6 hypothesis; profile supplies attenuation decay and emission peak
mine_fiber_layout | 3 | counts | diagonal_corner_fan from quick_corner_fan.conf
mine_readout_end | 0 | counts | Physical sensor end 0 or 1; one response per run
mine_wls_trapping_efficiency | 0.031 | counts | Per end fraction conditional on re-emission; 0.062 for both ends before attenuation
mine_coupling_efficiency | 1 | counts | Neutral coupling factor to be measured
mine_fiber_length | 0 | mm | Extra tail after geometrical route; sole path with layout 0
ideal_SiPM | 0 | counts | 1 gives PDE unity no saturation no dark no cross-talk no afterpulse; preserves photon statistics
mine_spectral_pde | 1 | counts | Use digitized Hamamatsu S13360-3075CS wavelength-dependent PDE at 25 C and plus 3 V
mine_photon_wavelength_nm | 425 | counts | Unshifted scintillation peak proxy in nm; WLS uses fiber profile peak
mine_gain | 1 | counts | Normalized charge per avalanche
mine_pixels | 1600 | counts | S13360-3075CS 3x3 mm 75 um cells
mine_crosstalk | 0.07 | counts | Datasheet typical at plus 3 V
mine_dark_rate | 0.0005 | counts | 500 kcps per device expressed in inverse ns
mine_afterpulse | 0 | counts | Not specified quantitatively in datasheet; disabled
mine_corner_fibers | 14 | counts | Even fiber count; no central fiber
mine_fiber_pitch | 100 | mm | Virtual vertices spacing on opposite diagonal
mine_corner_diagonal | 0 | counts | 0 bl_tr; 1 tl_br
mine_fiber_z | 0.5 | mm | Fiber centerline Z
mine_min_bend_radius | 100 | mm | Single clad Non-S 1 mm reference
mine_curve_step | 2 | mm | Curve discretization step
mine_sensor_pitch | 1.2 | mm | End packing pitch where used; corner paths share exact endpoints
